scope: Coverage mapping for the repository's stated first mapping pass. This file does not assert that the list is exhaustive enough for E1 PASS.
authority_note: CORE_0.1_COMPLETENESS_CHECKLIST.md names Chad Coulter as owner of E1. This mapping is contributor evidence only.

targets.name: functions and relations
targets.rationale: The foundational functions node represents the current function/relation entry point.

targets.name: limits and continuity
targets.rationale: Both concepts are explicit inventory nodes.

targets.name: rates of change
targets.rationale: The derivative-applications node explicitly includes rates.

targets.name: derivatives
targets.rationale: Definition and operational rules are represented separately.

targets.name: accumulation
targets.rationale: The integral branch represents accumulation and its applications.

targets.name: definite and indefinite integration
targets.rationale: Definite integration and antiderivative/indefinite integration are both explicit.

targets.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
targets.rationale: The theorem is an explicit inventory node.

targets.name: sequences and series
targets.rationale: The series branch covers sequence convergence, infinite series, and power series.

targets.name: parametric representation
targets.rationale: Added as a concept-level node with evidence-backed dependencies.

targets.name: polar representation
targets.rationale: Added as a concept-level node with evidence-backed dependencies.

targets.name: vectors and vector-valued functions
targets.rationale: Vector foundations and vector-valued functions are represented separately.

targets.name: partial derivatives
targets.rationale: Partial derivatives are an explicit inventory node.

targets.name: multiple integration
targets.rationale: Multiple integrals are an explicit inventory node.

targets.name: vector fields
targets.rationale: Vector fields are an explicit inventory node.

targets.name: ordinary differential equations
targets.rationale: First- and second-order ODE concepts are represented.

targets.name: systems of differential equations
targets.rationale: Systems of ODEs are an explicit inventory node.

targets.name: qualitative / phase behavior
targets.rationale: Slope-field/qualitative methods and phase portraits represent this family.

limits: The repository calls this list a starting inventory, not an exhaustive conventional-calculus taxonomy.
A complete 17/17 mapping against this list is therefore evidence of initial-list representation only, not E1 PASS.
Named topics elsewhere in the research document may still warrant separate concept nodes or coverage review.
